CREATE TABLE app_releases (
	platform TEXT NOT NULL, 
	channel TEXT NOT NULL, 
	version_code INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	min_supported INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rollout_percent INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	download_url TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, 
	release_notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	is_mandatory BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	released_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (platform, channel, version_code)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_app_releases_platform_channel_released ON app_releases (platform, channel, released_at)

CREATE TABLE attachment_kinds (
	code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code)
)

CREATE TABLE cargo_types (
	code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code)
)

CREATE TABLE clients (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	inn TEXT NOT NULL, 
	contact TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE document_types (
	code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	required BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code)
)

CREATE TABLE event_types (
	code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	primitive TEXT NOT NULL, 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	"order" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	min_app_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code)
)

CREATE TABLE feature_flags (
	code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	rollout_percent INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code)
)

CREATE TABLE inbox (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	source TEXT NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	received_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE integration_jobs (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	integration TEXT NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE notification_channels (
	code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code)
)

CREATE TABLE notification_templates (
	code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	channel TEXT NOT NULL, 
	template TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code)
)

CREATE TABLE point_types (
	code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code)
)

CREATE TABLE sync_cursors (
	device_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	last_sync_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	last_event_id UUID, 
	PRIMARY KEY (device_id)
)

CREATE TABLE trip_types (
	code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code)
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	phone TEXT NOT NULL, 
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	role TEXT NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_users_phone UNIQUE (phone)
)

CREATE TABLE access_scopes (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	scope_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	scope_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_access_scopes_user_type ON access_scopes (user_id, scope_type)

CREATE TABLE audit_log (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	action TEXT NOT NULL, 
	entity_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	entity_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	platform TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_audit_entity ON audit_log (entity_type, entity_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_audit_user_created ON audit_log (user_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE checklist_templates (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	cargo_type_code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	trip_type_code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	client_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cargo_type_code) REFERENCES cargo_types (code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trip_type_code) REFERENCES trip_types (code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES clients (id)
)

CREATE TABLE devices (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	platform TEXT NOT NULL, 
	os_version TEXT, 
	app_version TEXT NOT NULL, 
	push_token TEXT, 
	push_provider TEXT, 
	last_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_devices_user_platform ON devices (user_id, platform)

CREATE TABLE driver_profiles (
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	full_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	license_number TEXT NOT NULL, 
	license_expires_at DATE NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE event_payload_schemas (
	event_type_code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	json_schema JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_type_code, schema_version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_type_code) REFERENCES event_types (code)
)

CREATE TABLE orders (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	client_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	cargo_type_code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	trip_type_code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_by UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES clients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cargo_type_code) REFERENCES cargo_types (code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trip_type_code) REFERENCES trip_types (code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE telegram_subscriptions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	chat_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_telegram_subscriptions_chat ON telegram_subscriptions (chat_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_telegram_subscriptions_user ON telegram_subscriptions (user_id)

CREATE TABLE user_consents (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	consent_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	policy_version TEXT NOT NULL, 
	platform TEXT NOT NULL, 
	accepted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	ip TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_user_consents_user_type ON user_consents (user_id, consent_type)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_user_consents_active_version ON user_consents (user_id, consent_type, policy_version) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE checklist_versions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	template_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT NOT NULL, 
	primitive_configs JSONB NOT NULL, 
	published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	published_by UUID, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(template_id) REFERENCES checklist_templates (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(published_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_checklist_versions_template_version ON checklist_versions (template_id, version)

CREATE TABLE refresh_tokens (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	device_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	token_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_refresh_tokens_hash ON refresh_tokens (token_hash)
CREATE INDEX ix_refresh_tokens_user ON refresh_tokens (user_id)

CREATE TABLE trips (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	order_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT NOT NULL, 
	config_snapshot_id UUID, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	closed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	track_number TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES orders (id)
)

CREATE TABLE attachments (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	owner_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	owner_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	trip_id UUID, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	storage_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	mime TEXT NOT NULL, 
	size BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 TEXT, 
	width INTEGER, 
	height INTEGER, 
	watermark_meta JSONB, 
	source TEXT NOT NULL, 
	version_of UUID, 
	state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	platform TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trip_id) REFERENCES trips (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(kind) REFERENCES attachment_kinds (code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(version_of) REFERENCES attachments (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_attachments_owner ON attachments (owner_type, owner_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_attachments_sha256 ON attachments (sha256)

CREATE TABLE cargo_units (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	trip_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	vin TEXT NOT NULL, 
	make TEXT NOT NULL, 
	model TEXT NOT NULL, 
	position_in_truck TEXT, 
	order_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trip_id) REFERENCES trips (id)
)

CREATE TABLE checklist_steps (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	event_type_code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	required BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	"order" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	scope TEXT NOT NULL, 
	hint_icon TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(version_id) REFERENCES checklist_versions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_type_code) REFERENCES event_types (code)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_checklist_steps_version_event_type ON checklist_steps (version_id, event_type_code)

CREATE TABLE completion_policies (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	rules_json JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(version_id) REFERENCES checklist_versions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE config_snapshots (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	trip_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_json JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_config_snapshots_trip UNIQUE (trip_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trip_id) REFERENCES trips (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(version_id) REFERENCES checklist_versions (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_config_snapshots_trip ON config_snapshots (trip_id)

CREATE TABLE export_jobs (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	trip_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT NOT NULL, 
	storage_key TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trip_id) REFERENCES trips (id)
)

CREATE TABLE location_tracks (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	client_track_id UUID, 
	device_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	trip_id UUID, 
	lat NUMERIC(9, 6) NOT NULL, 
	lon NUMERIC(9, 6) NOT NULL, 
	accuracy_m INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	speed_mps NUMERIC, 
	bearing_deg NUMERIC, 
	location_source TEXT NOT NULL, 
	recorded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	received_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trip_id) REFERENCES trips (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_tracks_device_recorded ON location_tracks (device_id, recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_tracks_trip_recorded ON location_tracks (trip_id, recorded_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_tracks_client_device ON location_tracks (client_track_id, device_id)

CREATE TABLE trip_participants (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	trip_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	role TEXT NOT NULL, 
	from_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	to_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trip_id) REFERENCES trips (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE trip_points (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	trip_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	point_type_code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	order_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	address TEXT NOT NULL, 
	lat NUMERIC(9, 6), 
	lon NUMERIC(9, 6), 
	planned_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trip_id) REFERENCES trips (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(point_type_code) REFERENCES point_types (code)
)

CREATE TABLE attachment_versions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	attachment_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	storage_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attachment_id) REFERENCES attachments (id)
)

CREATE TABLE derived_assets (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	attachment_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	storage_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attachment_id) REFERENCES attachments (id)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	client_event_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	device_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	trip_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	point_id UUID, 
	cargo_unit_id UUID, 
	event_type_code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	payload_jsonb JSONB NOT NULL, 
	payload_schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	device_time_utc TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	device_tz_offset_min INTEGER, 
	elapsed_realtime_ms BIGINT, 
	server_time_utc TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	clock_skew_ms INTEGER, 
	time_trust TEXT NOT NULL, 
	lat NUMERIC(9, 6), 
	lon NUMERIC(9, 6), 
	accuracy_m INTEGER, 
	location_source TEXT, 
	state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	corrects_event_id UUID, 
	created_by UUID NOT NULL, 
	app_version TEXT NOT NULL, 
	platform TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_events_client_device UNIQUE (client_event_id, device_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trip_id) REFERENCES trips (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(point_id) REFERENCES trip_points (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cargo_unit_id) REFERENCES cargo_units (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_type_code) REFERENCES event_types (code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(corrects_event_id) REFERENCES events (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_events_trip_created ON events (trip_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_events_trip_type ON events (trip_id, event_type_code)

CREATE TABLE notification_log (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	event_id UUID, 
	template_code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	recipient TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sent_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	error TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_notification_event_recipient UNIQUE (event_id, recipient), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_notification_event FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES events (id)
)

CREATE TABLE outbox (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	event_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT NOT NULL, 
	retries INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	next_attempt_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES events (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_outbox_status_next ON outbox (status, next_attempt_at)
ALTER TABLE trips ADD CONSTRAINT fk_trips_snapshot FOREIGN KEY(config_snapshot_id) REFERENCES config_snapshots (id)
CREATE TRIGGER events_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_fact_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON audit_log FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_fact_mutation()
